title: hud
description: Configures whether elements of the on-screen display (alternately known as the 'heads up display', or 'HUD') are visible on the screen.

target.title: target
target.description: Selector of the player(s) to toggle visibility for.

visible.title: visible
visible.description: State to change the HUD element visibility to.

hud_element.title: hud_element
hud_element.description: Specific HUD element to configure visibility for.
